title: Inevitability & Acceptance: Úgyis így történt volna

sections.title: Accepting Unchangeable Realities
sections.content: You know the past conditional from B1 Unit 39. To say that something would have happened anyway, Hungarian uses *úgyis így történt volna* (it would have happened this way anyway) or *elkerülhetetlen lett volna* (it would have been unavoidable).

items.spanish: Felesleges bánkódni: előbb vagy utóbb úgyis kiderült volna az igazság.
items.english: It is pointless to grieve: sooner or later the truth would have come out anyway.

items.spanish: A szakítás elkerülhetetlen lett volna a nézetkülönbségek miatt.
items.english: The parting would have been unavoidable due to differences in perspective.

items.spanish: Ha akkor nem szóltunk volna, a baj úgyis megtörtént volna.
items.english: If we had not said anything then, the trouble would have happened anyway.
